requirements: R1: Implement missing Moodle SSO integration with autonomous fallback and resolve HTTP 401 errors on employee dossier endpoints.
R2: Fix the root cause of the environment startup database migration crash without suppression and correct the hallucinated review verdict.

slices.title: Resolve self-falsification findings across recent pull requests
slices.jtbd: When implementing the fixes for this epic, I want to address the missing SSO code, correct the migration suppression, and rectify the hallucinated review verdict, so that the self-falsification audit findings are fully resolved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a request to the employee dossier endpoint, When an authenticated user accesses it, Then it should integrate with Moodle SSO and return the correct data without 401 errors.
Given the application startup sequence, When database migrations are applied, Then they should run correctly without relying on SPRING_FLYWAY_IGNORE_MIGRATION_PATTERNS.
Given the PR review process, When verifying the diff, Then the review verdict must accurately reflect the code changes without hallucinating deleted entities or migrations.
